items.requirement: Critical journeys, invariants, and failure paths have evidence.
items.rationale: Phase completion records, the compatibility inventory, simulations, parity cases, failure tests, documentation examples, and the full repository gate cover the current experimental surface.

items.requirement: Dependencies are locked, audited, and licensed appropriately.
items.rationale: The exact uv lock is enforced; the 2026-09-20 runtime audit found no known vulnerabilities and the repository license-policy check passed. CI and release workflows rerun both controls.

items.requirement: The stable 1.0 scope and compatibility meaning are approved.
items.rationale: ADR-010 does not exist, so the stable API and precise meaning of 1.0 are not approved.
items.resolution_condition: Approve ADR-010 with the exact stable core, compatibility claim, and change policy.

items.requirement: The required candidate series and external beta program are complete.
items.rationale: The fail-closed registry contains zero candidates and zero external feedback and retains three program blockers.
items.resolution_condition: Pass the Phase 9 candidate/beta exit gate with genuine approved candidates and external feedback.

items.requirement: Independent statistical, numerical, security, API, and documentation reviews have retained exact-scope decisions.
items.rationale: Review execution has been reported complete, but the repository contains no durable Phase 9 records identifying the reviewed scope, findings, dispositions, reviewers, dates, and exact source revision. Existing Phase 3-5 approvals do not approve Phase 9.
items.resolution_condition: Retain the five Phase 9 review decisions and resolve every blocking finding.

items.requirement: The semantic-version tag exactly matches approved project metadata.
items.rationale: The check is enforced, but project metadata remains 0.1.0 and no approved 1.0 release tag exists.
items.resolution_condition: Set approved candidate/final metadata and pass tag verification on the exact tagged commit.

items.requirement: Clean full-matrix builds and isolated wheel/sdist installations pass on one revision.
items.rationale: The four-cell contract is implemented, but its first retained same-revision evidence set has not been aggregated.
items.resolution_condition: Retain and aggregate passing Ubuntu/macOS by Python 3.11/3.12 reports from one clean revision.

items.requirement: Build artifacts, checksums, SBOM, signatures/provenance, and changelog are traceable to the exact release commit.
items.rationale: The release workflow builds artifacts and a CycloneDX SBOM, but no approved release artifact set, signature/attestation, or exact-tag provenance record exists.
items.resolution_condition: Complete the Phase 9 signed/traceable-artifact deliverable for the exact approved tag.

items.requirement: Secrets and private or restricted data are absent from source, evidence, and artifacts.
items.rationale: Full-history secret scanning is mandatory, fixtures are synthetic or public, and evidence contracts prohibit personal and restricted fields.

items.requirement: Project memory is current, evidence-linked, deduplicated, and free of restricted material.
items.rationale: Memory records identify durable decisions and open threads without credentials, personal data, raw telemetry, or hidden reasoning.

items.requirement: Tracked work notes are closed or current and contain no raw telemetry.
items.rationale: The notes directory contains policy only; current unresolved work is maintained in the project-memory open-thread registry.

items.requirement: Threats, migrations, compatibility, and recovery boundaries were reviewed.
items.rationale: The threat model, risk register, complete namespace disposition, migration planner, and deprecation contract identify current boundaries and owners. Operational response procedures remain a separate blocked control.

items.requirement: Logs, metrics, alerts, capacity, and operational ownership are adequate.
items.rationale: Holocron is an offline library with no hosted service, daemon, production data store, or operational control plane.

items.requirement: Applicable production latency, overload, replay, and regression budgets have evidence.
items.rationale: The library declares no production latency or hosted-capacity SLA. Retained deterministic call and memory profiles remain regression diagnostics, not a production SLO.

items.requirement: Remaining material risks have owners and response triggers.
items.rationale: Material statistical, numerical, provenance, security, naming, continuity, and scope risks have named owners or explicitly vacant required roles and stop conditions.

items.requirement: Material agent-assisted work has requirements, evidence-changing verification, stop rules, and accountable risk ownership.
items.rationale: Repository policy requires requirement linkage, independent checks, declared stop/rollback conditions, evidence-backed handoff, and maintainer accountability.

items.requirement: Applicable telemetry and error events use a versioned schema and reproducible improvement review.
items.rationale: The package emits no remote telemetry and has no telemetry event pipeline.

items.requirement: Telemetry storage, shipping, and query systems have fault, capacity, privacy, recovery, and rollback evidence.
items.rationale: No telemetry collector, store, shipper, or query service exists.

items.requirement: Supported versions, compatibility response, lifecycle, and user support ownership are approved.
items.rationale: The security contact is named, but the Phase 9 support policy and stable compatibility-response commitments do not yet exist.
items.resolution_condition: Approve the support policy and compatibility-response commitments for the stable scope.

items.requirement: Incident, vulnerability, rollback/yank, and compatibility-response procedures are executable and owned.
items.rationale: Vulnerability intake targets exist, but complete release incident, artifact yank, rollback, and compatibility-response runbooks remain a later Phase 9 deliverable.
items.resolution_condition: Complete and exercise the Phase 9 response procedures.
